capturedAt: 2026-10-06 (capture 10:10–10:19 UTC; logical-section re-shoot same day) — live https://www.sparkonomy.com/
note: Logical sections (from data/annotations.json). The DOM only has 5 top-level nodes; see automaticDomNodes.

sections.name: Header / navigation (incl. cookie banner + mobile menu)
sections.purpose: Persistent brand mark and route to the four other site areas, plus the always-visible primary conversion CTA ("Claim your Creator Record") to the external Open Creator Graph app. On mobile the links collapse into a full-screen menu that also carries the partner and compliance badges. On first visit a CookieYes consent bar is overlaid at the top.

domNode.note: `<header class="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-40">` + CookieYes `.cky-consent-container` (injected by a third-party script)

sections.background: Transparent; legibility comes from the 112px black→transparent scrim. The header does not change on scroll (no background, shadow, shrink or hide-on-scroll — verified with screenshots at 900px and 1200px scroll). Mobile menu panel: solid `#000000`.
sections.layout: Fixed, full-width, transparent bar (z-index 40) with a 112px-tall top scrim (`linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.75), rgba(0,0,0,.35), transparent)`). Inner row: `max-width: 84rem` (1344px), `padding: 20px 32px` (desktop) / `16px 20px` (mobile), `display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center`, height 79.5px. Left: wordmark image 26px tall (24px <768px). Right (≥768px): `<nav aria-label="Main">` flex row, `gap: 28px`, four 13px text links then the gradient pill CTA. <768px: the nav is hidden and a 32×32 hamburger button (24px-wide PNG icon) toggles `#story-menu`, a `100svh` black panel (`padding: 16px 24px 40px`) under the bar.
sections.visualAssets: `logo_header_white.png` (991×188 wordmark, rendered 137×26), `hamburger_icon.png` (92×60, rendered 24px wide, mobile only). Mobile menu: 4 partner logos (26px tall, opacity .7) and 4 compliance badges (22px tall, opacity .55). Cookie banner: CookieYes `close.svg` and inline CookieYes wordmark SVG (78×13).
sections.interaction:
- Nav links: `color rgba(255,255,255,.6)` → `#FFFFFF` on hover, `transition: color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`.
- CTA pill: continuous `cta-sweep` gradient animation (3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate); hover `opacity: .9` (150ms).
- Hamburger: toggles `aria-expanded`, sr-only label switches "Open menu" ↔ "Close menu", icon swaps to an X drawn with two 24×1.5px white bars rotated ±45°. Menu opens/closes instantly (HTML `hidden` attribute, no transition), locks `body { overflow: hidden }`, closes on Escape, on link tap, or when the viewport becomes ≥768px.
- `pointer-events: none` on the header wrapper so the WebGL canvas behind keeps receiving pointer moves; only links/buttons are `pointer-events: auto`.
- Cookie banner (CookieYes): "Reject All"/"Accept All" buttons `rgb(107,114,128)` → `rgb(184,30,102)` + `filter: brightness(.9)` on hover; close (×) button; "Powered by CookieYes" link. The footer "Cookie Policy" button (`.cky-banner-element`) re-opens it.
sections.cta: Claim your Creator Record → https://creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com (`target="_blank" rel="noopener"`); same CTA repeated full-width inside the mobile menu.
sections.notes:
- The CookieYes bar (fixed top, `z-index: 9999999`, black, 10px radius, 520px wide on desktop / full width minus 12px gutters on mobile) sits on top of the header and on desktop hides the "About"/"Contact" links until dismissed; on mobile it covers the hero wordmark.
- Logo link has `aria-label="Sparkonomy home"` → `/`.
- No language switcher, search, login or account entry on the homepage header.

extra.caption: Desktop, first visit: CookieYes bar overlapping the nav

sections.name: Hero — "Sparkonomy" + Open Creator Graph launch card
sections.purpose: Brand statement (animated wordmark + tagline "Sparking Creator livelihoods.") and the launch announcement for the first product, Open Creator Graph, with the primary CTA. Credibility via a "built with" partner-logo marquee (Meta, YouTube, Google for Startups, Gemini). Ends with a "READ OUR STORY" cue that starts the scroll story.
sections.background: Shared fixed WebGL fluid canvas (black base, colourful ink plumes) + fixed radial vignette `radial-gradient(ellipse 68% 54% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.62) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.34) 46%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 76%)`. Launch card: fill `#8134AF33` (violet at 20%), 1px gradient border `linear-gradient(133.52deg, #DE0075 5.08%, #8134AF 28.61%)` drawn with a mask (`mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude, linear-gradient(#000 0 0)`), plus a soft glow behind it (desktop only) `radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 50%, rgba(221,0,117,.22), rgba(129,52,175,.12) 45%, transparent 75%)` extending 160px/112px beyond the card.
sections.layout: `section#opening`: `min-height: 100svh`, flex column, centred, `padding: 80px 24px 64px` (desktop) / `96px 24px 40px` (mobile), `text-align: center`. Stack: H1 wordmark (96px desktop / clamp(2.75rem,13vw,3.5rem) ≈ 50.7px at 390px) → tagline (24px desktop / 16px mobile, `margin-top: 16px`) → launch card (`max-width: 35rem` = 560px desktop, `23rem` = 368px mobile; `border-radius: 28px`; `padding: 40px 40px 28px` desktop / `36px 16px 32px` mobile; `margin-top: 36px`) → partner marquee (560px wide, `margin-top: 32px`; full-bleed on mobile, `margin-top: 48px`) → READ OUR STORY (`margin-top: 48px`). Before the intro completes, the card row is collapsed (`grid-template-rows: 0fr`) and a flex spacer above the H1 grows so the wordmark sits in the vertical centre (see Animations).
sections.visualAssets: Open Creator Graph mark `/logos/ocg-mark.webp` (160×160, rendered 80×80 desktop / 72×72 mobile, preloaded, `loading="eager"`, alt ""). Partner logos (white PNG via next/image, rendered 36px tall, opacity .75): Meta_White.png, Yt_White.png, Google_White.png, Gemini_White.png — list rendered twice for the seamless loop (second copy `aria-hidden`, alt ""). Inline SVG chevron 14×8 under READ OUR STORY.
sections.interaction:
- Intro sequence on load (3,000ms timer or first wheel/touchmove/keydown): card row expands, card fades/slides in at +1,000ms, marquee row at +1,700ms, READ OUR STORY at +2,200ms; fluid background receives a 10-splat burst.
- Wordmark: letters pulse (0.5s alternate, staggered 0.1s) and the word floats 10px up/down (2s alternate).
- CTA: `cta-sweep` gradient animation, hover opacity .9.
- Partner marquee: 24s linear infinite loop, starts 1,700ms after the intro, paused while the hero is off-screen.
- READ OUR STORY: bounces 7px + colour pulse (1.4s loop); click starts the automatic "story tour" (auto-scroll through every beat).
sections.cta: Claim your free Creator Record → https://creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com (new tab). Secondary: "READ OUR STORY" button (no href; triggers the auto-scroll tour).
sections.notes:
- The H1 contains an sr-only "Sparkonomy" plus an `aria-hidden` copy split into 10 coloured `<span>` letters, so DOM innerText reads "Sparkonomy\nSparkonomy".
- "NEW", "BY SPARKONOMY" and "READ OUR STORY" are uppercase via CSS; source strings are "New", "by Sparkonomy", "Read our story".
- The hero is the only screen not pinned (normal flow, 100svh).

sections.name: Story 1 — "For 15 years, we helped build YouTube from inside Google."
sections.purpose: Founder credibility: the team's 15-year history building YouTube at Google, and the emotional hook — the Creators.
sections.background: Transparent over the fixed fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Scroll-pinned "screen": `section#roots` is 255svh tall (2,295px at 1440×900); its child is `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`, flex-centred, `padding: 0 24px`; text block `max-width: 64rem` (1024px; 46rem below 768px), centred. 2 beats: H2 (64px/76.8px bold desktop; 44px/52.8px mobile) then body (28.8px/43.2px desktop; 20px/30px mobile, `margin-top: 24px`).
sections.interaction: Beat 1 (H2) fades in and rises 16px between 6.0% and 14.8% of the section's scroll travel; beat 2 (body) between 33.5% and 42.3%. Body words then "ink" from white to `rgba(255,255,255,.75)` one by one (≈15 characters/second, 500ms per word). Whole screen fades out over the last 10% of its travel. Scrolling stirs the fluid background.
sections.notes: On mobile the line break moves: "For 15 years, we / helped build / YouTube from / inside Google." (44px, natural wrap) and body "But what stayed with us were / the Creators / who brought it to life."

sections.name: Story 2 — "Students. / Homemakers. / Doctors. / Farmers."
sections.purpose: Shows who Creators are — ordinary people from every walk of life who built a living on camera.
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Pinned screen, 420svh (3,780px desktop), overlapping the previous screen by `margin-top: -100svh`. 5 beats: four stacked block lines inside one H2 (64px, `line-height: 1.55` = 99.2px desktop; 44px/74.8px mobile) then a body line (28.8px desktop / 20px mobile).
sections.interaction: Each word-line appears on its own beat (windows start at 6.0%, 20.0%, 34.0%, 48.0%, 62.0% of travel, each 4.5% long); body words ink to white/75. In the automatic tour these beats glide 500ms apart (`data-tour-beat-ms="500"`).
sections.notes: Alternating colours: Students. `#8134AF` (violet), Homemakers. `#DE0075` (magenta), Doctors. `#8134AF`, Farmers. `#DE0075`.

sections.name: Story 3 — "And we saw what it takes."
sections.purpose: Empathy for the solo Creator: no crew, no scriptwriter, no one else — just one person showing up every day.
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Pinned screen, 420svh, `margin-top: -100svh`. 5 beats: H2 (64px), three 28.8px lines ("No crew." / "No scriptwriter." / "No one else.", `space-y` 4px desktop / 12px mobile, white 100%), then a 64px bold payoff (32px/36.8px mobile, `margin-top: 24px`).
sections.interaction: Mode "soften": as each new beat enters, the previous middle line fades to 75% opacity. In the payoff, "one person" is magenta immediately; "every day" starts white and transitions to magenta (`color 600ms ease-in-out`, delays 900ms and 1,200ms after the line is fully revealed). Tour glide between these beats: 1,000ms.
sections.notes: Highlight colour `#DE0075` on "one person" and "every day".

sections.name: Story 4 — "Creators built a new profession."
sections.purpose: States the problem: Creators built a profession, but too little was built for them.
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.interaction: Same beat reveal (opacity 0→1, translateY 16px→0) and word-ink as Story 1.

sections.name: Story 5 — "For years, we built the platform."
sections.purpose: The turn: from building the platform (YouTube) to building for the Creators.
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Pinned screen, 255svh, `margin-top: -100svh`. 2 beats: H2 64px; then a 43.92px bold line (clamp(2rem,3.05vw,2.75rem); 32px mobile), `max-width: 52rem`, `margin-top: 16px` (24px mobile).
sections.notes: Second line coloured `#DD2A7B` (pink). Mobile H2 breaks "For years, / we built / the platform."

sections.name: Story 6 — "That's why we built Sparkonomy."
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Pinned screen, 200svh, `margin-top: -100svh`. 1 beat containing H2 (64px) + body (28.8px).
sections.interaction: After the beat appears, the H2 words ink from white to magenta `#DE0075` word by word, then the body words ink from white to white/75 (body starts when the heading's ink timeline ends).
sections.notes: The heading ends fully magenta; captured mid-transition in `_motion/word-ink-mission-*.png`.

sections.name: Creator Record — Open Creator Graph product demo
sections.purpose: Product proof: an example "Creator Record" (identity + AI-usage consent per facet, cryptographically timestamped and certified) next to the value proposition and the second primary CTA.
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette. Card: 1px gradient border `linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(151,71,255,.7), rgba(222,0,117,.5) 55%, rgba(151,71,255,.6))`, radius 24px; inner panel `#321935`, radius 23px, `padding: 24px`; blurred glow behind (`linear-gradient(133.52deg, #DE0075 5.08%, #8134AF 56.74%)`, `blur(40px)`, opacity .6).
sections.layout: `section#ocg` is NOT pinned: normal flow, `min-height: 100svh`, `padding: 96px 24px`. Content `max-width: 54rem` (864px; 40rem mobile). H2 (2 lines, 64px) + body (28.8px). Below (`margin-top: 56px`): desktop/tablet ≥768px a 2-column grid `grid-template-columns: 21.25rem 1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center` — card (340px) left, H3 + pitch + CTA right; the grid is `position: sticky` with `top = max(88px, (100vh − height)/2)` (348px at 900px tall) plus a 60svh spacer, so it holds in the middle while the heading scrolls away. Mobile: single column, card (max 25rem) then H3 + CTA.
sections.visualAssets: Avatar `/CD.png` (40×40 round, rendered from 183×181 original), verified tick inline SVG 16×16 (`#334CCA` circle + white check), "CERTIFIED" stamp `/Certified-1.png` (rendered 112×70; original 3238×2018), stance pills.
sections.interaction:
- Card is lazy-mounted when within 300px of the viewport (200px placeholder).
- Desktop/tablet: card always expanded. Mobile: shows only header + claims + "AI Usage" summary until the H2 scrolls under the header (bottom < 72px), then expands (height animation 0.9s, ease `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`; collapses in 0.54s when scrolled back past 160px); facet rows stagger in (0.08s apart, start delay 0.12s, each 0.45s: opacity 0→1, y 8→0); "Certified" stamp fades in (0.4s, delay 0.63s).
- CTA sweep animation paused while the CTA is off-screen; hover opacity .9.
sections.cta: Claim your free Creator Record → https://creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com (new tab).
sections.notes:
- Stance colours: Allowed `#34C759`, Conditional `#E5B607`, Prohibited `#E5484D` — text, 1px border and an 8% tint fill (`…14` hex alpha); 108px-wide pills with a 6px dot.
- The bundled data also defines a "not declared" stance (white) and a 5-step "Day 1 … Day 30" narrative that is not rendered on the homepage.
- Example persona "Chulbuli Dixit" (@chulbulidixit) is illustrative demo content.

sections.name: Closing — "And we're only getting started."
sections.purpose: Forward-looking sign-off and brand sign line "Let's spark together."
sections.background: Transparent over the fluid canvas + vignette.
sections.layout: Pinned screen, 310svh (no negative overlap, it follows the flow section). 3 beats: H2 64px (`max-width: 18rem` on mobile), body 28.8px (`margin-top: 24px`), sign line 43.92px bold (`margin-top: 36px`; 32px mobile).
sections.interaction: Beat reveal + word ink as other story screens. This screen does not fade out at the end (it hands over to the footer).
sections.cta: None (no CTA in the closing screen; the header CTA remains visible).

sections.name: Footer
sections.purpose: Secondary navigation (products, company, legal), compliance badges, copyright and social profiles.
sections.layout: `<footer>` `background: #000; padding: 0 40px 48px` (24px sides mobile), `position: relative; z-index: 10`. Inner `max-width: 84rem`, `border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)`, `padding-top: 56px` (40px mobile). Desktop grid `grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr auto; gap: 40px` → [wordmark + "Compliant with" badges] [Products] [Company] [Terms & Policies]. Then a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.1)` divider (`margin-top: 56px`) and a centred column (`gap: 24px`): copyright, then 5 social icons (24×24, `gap: 28px`). Mobile: wordmark, then a 2-column grid (Products + Company stacked left, Terms & Policies right), then "Compliant with", divider, copyright, icons.
sections.visualAssets: `logo_header_gray.png` (523×96, rendered 131×24; grey wordmark with a purple paw-print "o"), compliance badges DPDP/CCPA/PDPA/GDPR (white PNG, 36×36, opacity .55), 5 inline SVG social icons (X, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit; `fill: currentColor`).
sections.interaction: Links and social icons `rgba(255,255,255,.5)` → white on hover (`transition: color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`). "Cookie Policy" is a `<button class="cky-banner-element">` that re-opens the CookieYes banner. External links open in a new tab (`rel="noopener"` for Open Creator Graph, `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for social).
sections.notes: Labels: column headings 14px/20px weight 500 white; links 14px/20px weight 400 white/50; copyright 14px white/50.
